# AEGIS - Human-AI Augmenting Systems

> AEGIS builds decision-support systems that augment human experts, never replace them. Founded by Dr Loh Kah Meng (Singapore). Every system pairs real, often-forgotten public data with an interpretable model and keeps a human in command. Mission: give dead datasets a faithful second life - "augment, never replace; honest metrics; share the knowledge."

## About
- [About AEGIS](https://aegishumanai.com/about.html): who we are and the human-in-command philosophy.
- [Prof Dhanjoo Ghista](https://aegishumanai.com/prof-dhanjoo-ghista.html): the Nondimensional Physiological Index lineage behind AEGIS.
- [Disclaimer](https://aegishumanai.com/disclaimer.html): illustrative research, not certified medical devices.

## Notes for agents
- All apps run entirely client-side; there is no backend REST API. Models are embedded and reproducible.
- Content is illustrative research for augmenting human experts - not a certified medical device.
- Contact: dean.kmloh@aegishumanai.com
